# Open Game SFX Index — CC0 game sound effects

Website: https://legerdo.github.io/open-game-sfx-index/
Catalog JSON (~2.5 MB, 1451 effects): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Legerdo/open-game-sfx-index/main/index.json
MCP and WebMCP integration: https://github.com/Legerdo/open-game-sfx-index/blob/main/docs/MCP.md
Agent search and licensing guide: https://github.com/Legerdo/open-game-sfx-index/blob/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md
License details: https://github.com/Legerdo/open-game-sfx-index/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md

On WebMCP-enabled browsers, the website exposes search_sfx, get_sfx,
list_sfx_categories, and preview_sfx. On coding agents, run the local stdio
MCP server from mcp/server.mjs to access the first three tools.
Search returns direct per-file audio URLs and CC0 source attribution.
Use the index and download only individual chosen sounds.
